ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 95%) with localized high-intensity white clusters and sparse linear streaks providing high contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the entire surface area; high-contrast white geometric blobs concentrated at both distal tips; sparse isolated white circular and linear pixel mappings on the interior lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior convergence point dividing the symmetrical lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, moderate-frequency serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, textured high-contrast pixel aggregates at the far left and right tips; single high-contrast white circular spot on the mid-left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of vertical white linear streaks on the inner left lobe; single diagonal white linear mark located in the center of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive cluster of barnacle colonization at both fluke tips; localized white scarring and linear rake-like marks across the ventral surface.
